description: Manage GSC property selection — list registered properties, switch the active one (re-navigates current page), read the active property from the URL, or open the Add Property dialog. [mutating for action=add — adds a new property to the Google account]

action.description: list = enumerate properties from picker; select = switch active property; current = read URL property; add = open Add Property dialog.

property.description: Property string (e.g. "sc-domain:example.com" or "https://example.com/") for select. For add: domain or URL prefix value.

tabId.description: Target a specific tab. Auto-resolved if omitted.

type.description: For add action: property type. Default: domain.

name: gsc_property
